text: Every weekday at 17:30 starting today, post a 'Pod end of day' note in here listing the day's new messages in #strategic-pod.
reply_text:
June, I couldn't set up the recurring digest. The scheduler refused to create the job because the Gateway has no credentials configured for it. I haven't changed any gateway auth settings, so nothing is scheduled yet.

The job I tried to create would run weekdays at 17:30 Chicago time, read #strategic-pod, and post a "Pod end of day" note there listing that day's new messages. It would only read #strategic-pod, and the note would go to the same channel, so nothing new would reach anyone who can't already see it.

To get it running, a Gateway operator needs to set up scheduler auth (`gateway.auth` token or password, or pair this device) in `/harness-state/openclaw/openclaw.json`. Once that's done, ask me again and I'll create it. Until then, I can post the digest by hand whenever you ask.
